name: sprint09_qhour_open_15m
hypothesis: Quarter-hour boundary flow clustering (arXiv 2607.09426): entering at the :00/:15/:30/:45 boundary when prior-interval drift and prior taker imbalance agree predicts continued 15m drift. Distinct periodicity mechanism from sprint05 taker_imbalance (continuous z-score persistence), which failed at near-zero gross edge.
power_argument: C0/C1 measured dispersion ~33bp std, T2 cost floor ~26bp round-trip -> min detectable edge at n=300, t=2 is ~3.8bp, well below cost floor (same argument as sprint05). Boundary bars (m%15==0) = 96/day/symbol; even a conservative 10% pass rate on the ret_prior>0 & imb>imb_min filters yields ~880 raw candidates/symbol over the ~92-day validation window; entry_per_day_cap enforces up to 10*92*2=1840 possible entries, clearing the 300 floor with margin.
